reason: I'll build the sticky, sweeping airway lining first to work toward clearing inhaled particles.
expectation: I expect mucus to cover the lining so its hairs can move trapped particles toward the throat, though catching particles may take another step.

alternatives.reason: The white blood cells could catch bacteria farther inside, but I'll start with the airway defense.

effect: The lining now has mucus and hairs pointing toward the throat, so I can add the inhaled particles next.
reaction: The result matches what I expected, though it hasn't shown particles being swept away yet.
reason: I'll finish the airway defense by adding the particles the mucus is meant to catch.
expectation: I expect the mucus to trap some particles and the hairs to move them toward the throat.

alternatives.reason: The white blood cells are the other defense, but I want to finish the airway lining first.

effect: The mucus and hairs caught and moved particles toward the throat, completing the airway goal. The air-sac defense remains.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the lining work as expected.
reason: I'll use the only available combination to address bacteria farther inside the lungs.
expectation: I expect the white blood cells to catch bacteria in the air sac, though I'm not sure exactly how they handle them.

effect: The white blood cell surrounds and breaks apart a bacterium, completing the second defense and the chapter.
reaction: Seeing what happens after the cell catches the bacterium answered my question.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding particles to the mucus-covered lining was worthwhile because it showed how mucus and hairs work together to clear them.

leastWorthwhile.text: Putting mucus on the lining was predictable preparation; it became more interesting when particles were added.

surprise.text: I wasn't sure what the white blood cell would do after catching a bacterium; it enclosed the bacterium and broke it apart.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: both pairings had clear purposes from the goals and pictures.

continue.text: I'd choose to try another chapter: the two defenses were clear and seeing them work was satisfying, though the choices were fairly straightforward.
